title: Home
content:
Welcome to Theo ⚡

Your local-first, keyboard-native developer workspace.

This is your workspace home. Everything lives here — notes, decisions, runbooks, API docs, and issues.

Quick Links

  • [[ADRs]] — Architecture Decision Records
  • [[RFCs]] — Request for Comments
  • [[Runbooks]] — Operational guides
  • [[API Documentation]] — Service endpoints

Getting Started

Press ⌘K to open the command palette and navigate to anything instantly.

Use ⌘P to fuzzy-search pages. Use ⌘I to jump to an issue.

Recent Activity

Everything you need to pick up where you left off is in the sidebar under Recents.

"The best tool is the one that gets out of your way."
